title: AES standard on interconnections — Standard for Presenting Signal Levels, Circuit Impedances, and Topologies of Analog Audio System Components for Product Data Sheets
abstract: This standard defines the format for device manufacturers to present a uniform description of their interfacing circuit capabilities. The intent of this standard is to enable system designers and users to better predict and understand 'what can work - with what - and how'. The performance of device interconnection depends on the tripartite interaction of the Driver (Transmitter), the Interconnecting Cable, and the Receiver (Input Load).
scope: A standard Datasheet disclosure framework to measure, document, and report characteristics, topologies, impedances, and interface parameters of analog audio devices.

foundational_principles.impedance_balance: Balance is an IMPEDANCE characteristic, not a voltage property. Common-Mode Rejection Ratio (CMRR) requires equal impedances to ground on both signal legs (Z_P = Z_R). Equal and opposite voltages are not required.
foundational_principles.voltage_transfer: Modern audio interconnection operates via bridging voltage transfer (Z_IN >= 10 × Z_OUT), not obsolete 600-ohm power matching.
foundational_principles.pin_1_enclosure_bond: Cable shields belong to the metallic chassis enclosure, never internal audio signal 0V.

part_1_mechanical_and_shielding.connector_type: XLR (AES14), 1/4" TRS (AES14id), DB25 (AES59), RJ45 (AES72), Terminal Block

differential_mode_impedance_DMZ.typical_values: Output: 50 Ω to 200 Ω (nominally ~136 Ω); Input: 10 kΩ to 100 kΩ

part_2_circuit_topology_and_impedances.impedance_balance_Zbal: Yes if |Z_P - Z_R| / Z_P <= 10% across 20 Hz to 20 kHz; otherwise No
part_2_circuit_topology_and_impedances.voltage_symmetry_Vsym: Yes if V_R = -V_P; No if V_R = 0 (impedance-balanced)

part_3_signal_levels_and_distortion.setup_reference_level: 0 dBu (0.775 V RMS) or +4 dBu (1.228 V RMS)
part_3_signal_levels_and_distortion.mezzanine_distortion_level: Maximum linear operating level at rated distortion (0.1% or 1% THD+N across 10 Hz - 50 kHz, typically +20 dBu to +24 dBu)
part_3_signal_levels_and_distortion.clipping_ceiling: Absolute hard clip level where waveform hits DC supply rails

part_4_common_mode_rejection.cmrr_matched: Measured with 0 Ω source imbalance across 20 Hz - 20 kHz
part_4_common_mode_rejection.cmrr_unbalanced_source: Measured with normative 10 Ω or 600 Ω source imbalance per IEC 60268-3

standardized_output_topologies.notes: True galvanic isolation, extreme RF/ground loop rejection, high cost.

standardized_output_topologies.v_sym: No (Audio on Pin 2, passive resistor on Pin 3)
standardized_output_topologies.notes: Full CMRR noise rejection, low power, safe when Pin 3 shorted to ground by TS plug.
Cross-coupled op-amps; automatically delivers 6 dB boost when Pin 3 grounded to maintain level.
Ground-referenced independent op-amps; shorting Pin 3 shorts active op-amp to ground.
Secondary center tap referenced to ground.

relevance_to_balanced_audio: The overarching synthesis standard for the entire SC-05-05 working group, providing engineers with the first standardized datasheet language to predict interoperability between audio devices.
